name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre discovered motorsport through his grandfather, a former mechanic for a rally team in the 1980s. The stories and the smell of gasoline were captivating, and he knew he wanted to be involved somehow. He started small, volunteering at local racing events, meticulously tracking inventory and helping with setup. His organizational skills were quickly noticed, and he transitioned into a junior logistics role with a regional touring car series. 

He brings a no-nonsense approach to logistics, prioritizing efficiency and thoroughness. He thrives under pressure and has a knack for anticipating potential problems before they arise. Jean-Pierre's ability to see the bigger picture, combined with his meticulous nature, makes him a valuable asset to any team, ensuring everything runs smoothly behind the scenes. He recently joined FVee Brasil seeking a new challenge and the opportunity to apply his skills in a different racing environment.
